correctness.rationale: For uniform π∈S_n, conditional on B_i=1, the first succession value H is uniform in 1..n−1 and the other positions form a random bijection. Counting H that preclude π(j)=j yields positive entries (n−2)/[n²(n−1)(n−2)] when j=1,n,i,i+1 and −2/[n²(n−1)(n−2)] elsewhere. Summing rows gives Cov(F,U)=2/[n(n−1)] with endpoint share (n−1)/n. Two distinct succession events have probability 1/[n(n−1)], even overlapping, by ordered-block counting, so Var(U)=(n²−n−1)/n². For covariance matrix M, endpoint row forces sum x_i=0 and interior rows force x_i=−x_(i−1); alternating vector sums to zero iff n is odd, giving rank n−2 odd, n−1 even. Independently exhaustively enumerated all permutations n=3..7 and checked 110 matrix entries.
